name: When is an egress window required during a basement finish?

mainEntity.name: When is an egress window required during a basement finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement bedrooms require an approved egress window to comply with local residential safety codes, whereas simple recreational rooms do not. An egress window gives occupants a direct escape route and allows emergency responders clear access during a fire. If your existing foundation only features small hopper or sliding windows, adding an egress window requires cutting concrete, excavating outside, and installing an egress well with a ladder. While this increases the upfront investment, adding a code-compliant bedroom significantly boosts overall home appraisal value.
acceptedAnswer.description: An egress window is mandatory if you include a bedroom or dedicated sleeping area in your basement finish plans to satisfy safety codes.
